lina-cs: quick heads-up  NimbusPay reports a steady rise in token spend and a handful of 'entity loss' bugs on finance Q/A. renewal in ~6w. health = amber. thinking: small-scope perf play: intent routing + compact model for FAQ + canaryed int8. thoughts?
omar-ml: agree. their telemetry: ~70% short Q/A, ~15% long summaries. cost concentrated on Q/A. compact+int8 should reduce cost; need entity-preserve tests.
felix-se: routing plan: tag intent:faq -> redwood/compact-qa-v0 (int8 candidate), intent:summarize -> prod-ppx-fp. Canary phases: 3% -> 20% -> 80% over 48h with metric gates.
sam: captured customer feedback: "answers are faster but account numbers sometimes drop dashes". request: objective eval before moving past 20%.
omar-ml: evaluation: assemble 400 anonymized entity-focused samples. metrics: entity_F1, formatting_preserve_rate, latency_p95, cost_per_1k. gate: formatting_preserve_rate >= 0.99 and entity_F1 within 1.0% of prod. rollback: auto-switch to prod-fp if entity_F1 drops >1.2% in rolling 60m.
felix-se: draft route (pseudo): {"match":"intent:faq","model":"redwood/compact-qa-v0-int8","weight":0.03} with fallback chain compact->int8-fallback->prod-fp and cache.prefix_ttl=300s.
deploy-bot: ticket created: CS-3201 "NimbusPay compact+quant pilot" assigned to @omar-ml,@felix-se,@lina-cs due 2026-06-10. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-3201 :white_check_mark:
lina-cs: thanks team  next steps: omar prepare eval + numbers, felix build canary script, sam get customer sign-off on eval set & rollback. i'll update renewal playbook once we have results. :thumbsup:
